description: "Cowley's Essays" by Abraham Cowley is a collection of philosophical essays written during the 17th century. This work presents Cowley's reflections on various subjects including liberty, solitude, obscurity, and agriculture, showcasing a deep engagement with the themes of personal freedom and the simplicity of rural life.
